# Results tables (generated by `tools/make_tables.py`)

cube-single-play-singletask-v0 -- which is OGBench **task 2**, not all five: the bare id has no task token and `cube_env.py` defaults `reward_task_id` to 2, so every row below except the five-task section is task 2 alone (antmaze/pointmaze rows are task 1, the mazes' default). 500-episode evals. Multiple seeds are mean ± 95% CI across seeds; a single seed shows its Wilson interval.

## Zero-shot across the five cube tasks (affine PSMFlow, 300k-500k)

One representation per seed; the reward function is inferred in closed form at eval (`infer_eval_z`), so all five tasks are read off the SAME checkpoints with no retraining. Every other cube row in this file is task 2 alone.

| task | n (ckpt x seed) | success, mean ± 95% CI | BC control | ratio vs BC |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| task 1 | 15 | 0.314 ± 0.123 | 0.152 [0.123, 0.186] | 2.1x |
| task 2 (the default id) | 15 | 0.415 ± 0.083 | 0.072 [0.052, 0.098] | 5.8x |
| task 3 | 15 | 0.480 ± 0.074 | 0.230 [0.195, 0.269] | 2.1x |
| task 4 | 15 | 0.100 ± 0.034 | 0.086 [0.065, 0.114] | 1.2x |
| task 5 | 15 | 0.113 ± 0.045 | 0.014 [0.007, 0.029] | 8.1x |
| **average over 5 task(s)** | -- | **0.284** | **0.111** | **2.6x** |

Full per-checkpoint breakdown and the figure: `docs/tables/affine_cube_multitask.md`, `docs/figures/2026-09-06-affine-cube-multitask.png` (`tools/fig_affine_multitask.py`).

## Provenance notes

- The FB-graft rows aggregate every `eval500_fbgraft_sd?_*.json` present; the previously quoted single-seed 0.064 predates sd0's JSONs landing (08-14 23:05).
- sd0 headline evals recorded before the P0.2 eval-seeding fix are not exactly reproducible (sd0 re-eval 0.240 vs recorded 0.318); the E2 re-eval rows are the post-fix measurement of the same checkpoints and supersede the PSMFlow headline row for comparisons.
- E1 oracle-aim (below) is a diagnostic, not an agent: an oracle picks among K=512 decoded prior latents using a frozen FQL expert's action.
